localChanges: chore: work towards a 3D map, not offered yet: under ?3d=1 with the realistic sets, Fanatics, Warriors and Engineers stand, walk and fall with their own clips, and Fanatics and Warriors strike in battle (#1386)

log: The Fanatic is rigged, on models-realistic-cc0's Partisan's idle, move and die, with a thrust of his own: he draws his torch back by his shoulder and thrusts it out upright at an enemy's face, its blow landing at 0.5 s.

His hands, made open, are curled (a stance's new `fingers`): his right a fist closed on the torch's shaft, which is laid across his palm on the axis his fingers curl round (`grip` closes them on it); his left hangs with its fingers together. His thumbs aren't curled (#25).
A clip's `strike` says when its blow lands; the manifest gives it as `rigged.strikes`, which the 3D map reads to time a melee blow and the attacker's lunge.
His die lands him at 84 degrees and lies him along the ground with his torch beside him; his feet are planted where his stance stands them.
Six fresh reviews; their findings are fixed, with #24, #25 and models-realistic-cc0#12, #35, #39 and #40 left for later.

The same stance, rig and check tools as models-realistic-by's, where the Fanatic's hands are curled and his thrust says when it lands (civ-clone/models-realistic-by#23). No model here uses the new keys, so nothing in models/ changes; the README mentions them.

A stance's `fingers` curls a hand made open: round an axis across it, from its knuckles, with `together` drawing splayed fingers together and `grip` closing them on a held prop. A prop held in a fist is laid on that axis (assemble.py).
A clip's `strike` says when its blow lands, in a clip played once with no shots; the manifest gives it as `rigged.strikes`.
check.py checks both as stance.py and rig.py read them. Six fresh reviews; their findings are fixed, with #12, #35, #39 and #40 left for later.
The Warriors and Engineers stand as they were made, their club, shield and rolled drawing held whole, and have the Partisans' idle, move and die, their arms carried over from where each holds them.
The Warriors' fight is an overhand blow with the club, raised behind him and brought down over his head, landing at 0.5 s (rigged.strikes), his shield brought forward to guard him.
Lying dead, a Warrior's club and shield lie on the ground beside him, and an Engineer's drawing lies beside him, his head forward so his hard hat's brim doesn't hold him up.
